scope: independent source/control/custody review only; no product tests or bodies

findings.subject: pristine comparator lacks required custody controls
findings.detail: It checks only one pre-run disk value, then directly execs pytest. It has no exact checkout SHA/tree/path or clean guard, no before/after source witnesses, no interpreter realpath/version witness, no raw stdout/stderr or pytest log custody, no after-body disk check, no continuous monitor, no one-heavy lock, and no status/exit/evidence propagation. This cannot satisfy the required full before/during/after pristine proof.

findings.subject: pristine route does not apply the D89d full-pair floor
findings.detail: The pristine script enforces only 4000000000 bytes and has no 4714564096-byte source admission floor or body-dispatch witness. D89d applies to the required Agent 8585/pristine 64197 full rerun pair.

findings.subject: pristine JUnit custody is not runnable as authored
findings.detail: The script writes to evidence/private/pristine/agent-core-full.xml but never creates its parent directory. The source packet has no such directory. It also does not pre-create or retain raw output files. A later service may provide incidental directories, but the authored command does not own the promised XML/raw custody.

findings.subject: controller admission is not genuinely authenticated or tuple-bound
findings.detail: admitted_dispatch reads an arbitrary JSON path and brief, checks only a schema, nonempty controller, service_id prefix, four witness fields, and a substring in the brief. It does not verify the existing request-test/test-run receipt identity or hash, exact service/request ID, controller receipt status, source tuple/tree, manifest, command, or brief hash. A stale or self-authored receipt/brief with the expected substring can pass. This is not the required binding through the existing authenticated route.

findings.subject: cut cannot consume the genuine future App receipt
findings.detail: The cut hardcodes a nonexistent sentinel App path and sentinel SHA/tree/parents. The positive manifest carries the same placeholders. No receipt path or authenticated App binding input is accepted. Until the App owner supplies the genuine freeze-2 receiving receipt and the normal controller binds it, the cut must refuse; this is a later receiving requirement, not source approval.

findings.subject: source packet misattributes the pristine SHA discrepancy
findings.evidence: source-manifest.json:agent_pristine.task_text_typo; source worker brief.md; git object check
findings.detail: The genuine source-worker manager brief records the authoritative pristine SHA ending 303a and does not contain 303e. Git confirms 303a exists and 303e is absent. The source-manifest field claiming that the task text ended 303e is unsupported by that manager brief and should not be carried as an input-history fact. The authoritative 303a object/tree are otherwise correct.

findings.subject: KEEP and dependent-directory custody are asserted, not enforced
findings.detail: The cut creates a writable text KEEP marker, but neither route protects the run/evidence directory or verifies file modes, inode/path identity, dependent directory custody, or post-run raw/XML dataflow. The pristine route has no KEEP marker at all. Launcher hashes cover selected manifest inputs, not the promised complete raw/dependent custody.

findings.subject: pristine environment is not the same operational settings
findings.detail: The cut environment includes the toolchain Node path and ASTRID_RUNTIME_SOURCE_ROOT; the pristine environment omits both. The pristine script also does not verify the venv interpreter realpath/version. This prevents the requested same-venv/settings parity from being evidenced.

findings.subject: source-work trace has a disclosed pre-trace gap
findings.detail: The genuine source-work trace has 44 samples at exact 5-second intervals from 05:00:57Z through 05:04:32Z, minimum 4693712896 bytes, all above 4 GB. The source dispatch witness was 04:57:57.501Z and the manager recorded no trace at 04:59:57Z, so custody before 05:00:57Z is unavailable. The older 254-sample trace belongs to retained receipt 26496 and is not backfilled as current source-work evidence.

later_receiving_requirements: Obtain and verify the genuine App freeze-2 receiving head/tree/parents receipt, then bind it through the existing normal route; do not use 520d, 8f278, 547e, or placeholders.
Issue exactly one normal controller admission receipt at >=4714564096 bytes and bind its exact request/service/source tuple and brief through existing authenticated receipt validation.
Run the Agent 8585 full body and the plain pristine 64197 full comparator with the corrected custody controls, then run the explicitly authorized selected CLI P4 reproof.
source_only_disposition: No source approval, REG, gate, or ship credit. Historical receipts remain unchanged.
